title: DOT-04: GAO-25-107166 Recommendation 1 identity and agency response
summary: DOT-04 resolves one-to-one to GAO-25-107166 Recommendation 1; the record preserves the affected component, current GAO status, agency response, and last visible update period.
key_findings: Phase 56P action: DOT should provide complete information to Congress on the status of Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act grant funding.
Affected component: Department of Transportation; Secretary.
Current GAO status: Open; status period: March 2026.
Agency response: DOT had not completed the action by March 2026. It described public reporting and a planned Grants Transparency Dashboard targeted for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.
Continuation rule: Recheck GAO-25-107166 Recommendation 1 when GAO changes the status or adds agency-response evidence after March 2026.
why_it_matters: The crosswalk replaces a letter-level local reference with an inspectable official report-and-recommendation identity where the evidence supports exactly one match.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves local action key DOT-04 as a crosswalk rather than an official identifier.
Separates official recommendation identity, affected entity, GAO status, agency response, implementation evidence, closure, and outcome.
Supports direct follow-through on GAO-25-107166 Recommendation 1.
evidence_limits: An agency response, concurrence, planned date, submission, or artifact under review does not by itself establish implementation or closure.
GAO recommendation status is not interchangeable with the Phase 56F entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, value, or causation.
The official identity is the report number plus recommendation number shown on the GAO product page; FTFN does not invent a separate opaque database identifier.
